summary: In Ansible 11.12.0, community.digitalocean is deprecated and will be removed from Ansible 13 unless someone maintains it.
questions: When will the DigitalOcean collection leave the Ansible package?

answer_card.title: community.digitalocean deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: `community.digitalocean` is deprecated and will be removed from Ansible 13 unless someone starts maintaining it again.
